notes.subject: Kristy call notes — handwritten outreach history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes say Parker Days Festival and 'must reach out by Oct for 2027.' Gmail confirms multiple years of Adventure Zone outreach, including an April 17, 2026 email to Dean after Kristy spoke with him. The official 2026 festival remained a very large family event with carnival rides and kids activities, so any pitch should be positioned as a separate staffed attraction rather than assuming they lack amusement.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: Kristy's handwritten instruction says to reach out by October for 2027. Continue from the existing Dean relationship and discuss whether a separate attraction area fits alongside the carnival.
